description: Return the section tree (table of contents) for a parsed (spec, edition). `depth` caps tree depth (1 = top-level only). `under` anchors at a specific clause id so you get just its descendants. Each node carries { id, number, title, kind, children }.

depth.description: Max tree depth to return. 1 = top-level only; 2 = first two levels; omitted = full tree.

edition.description: Edition within the chosen spec. ECMA-262: es2016 … es2026, main. ECMA-402: es2016 … es2026, main. Aliases: latest, draft, next.

spec.description: Which TC39 spec to read: '262' (core language, default) or '402' (Internationalization API).

under.description: Optional clause id. If set, return only descendants of this clause.

name: clause.outline
title: Spec section outline
